text: Entry 502 replaces a runtime-variable cstr! argument with literal macro calls in each PrefName match arm and fixes one leftover experimental c literal. Current generic outgoing code uses c literals. Use the project toolchain and the accepted current implementation when choosing syntax. This follow-up repairs the reland stack; it does not establish a permanent c-literal ban. The exact review D216006 remains pending.
